name: <launch folder name, unique under flightdeck/launch/>
status: <draft | active | accepted | accepted-with-reservations | abandoned | partial; exactly one launch is active>
phase: <targets | plan | contracts | implement | verify | review | report | ended, in that order>

spec.name: <spec name, the folder under launch/specs/>
spec.commit: <hash the spec was frozen at, null while draft>
spec.file_commit: <hash of the last commit touching the spec file, informational, may be null>
spec.path: <path to the pinned copy, relative to this launch folder>

tests_map.commit: <hash the map was frozen at, null while draft>
tests_map.path: <path to the pinned copy, relative to this launch folder>

lock_commit: <hash at the tests-map pin; the base for boundary, locked and the critic diff; null until pinned>
branch: <integration branch for this run, run/<name> by default>
previous_launch: <name of the newest other launch for the same spec, or null>
allow_draft: <boolean, true when activation or pinning accepted a draft>

locked: <glob no edit may touch while the launch is past phase targets>
paths.enforce_boundary: <boolean, true from the tests-map pin onwards>

structural.<file extension, with the dot>: <command run after every edit of that extension, containing {file}>

ceilings.turns_per_agent: <integer, at most the implementer's own maxTurns>
ceilings.gate_iterations: <integer, consecutive stop blocks allowed at a gate>
ceilings.stop_blocks: <integer, at most 8; the stop gate caps at min(this, 8)>
ceilings.minutes: <integer, wall clock from first to last event>
ceilings.tokens: <integer ceiling, or null when tokens are not counted>

outcome: <the outcome given to fc launch end, null until then>
ended: <iso timestamp of the ending, null until then>
accepted_units: <unit id kept by a partial ending; absent otherwise>
abandoned_units: <unit id dropped by a partial ending; absent otherwise>
